You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From cf86bb53b9c92354904a328e947a05ffbfdd1840 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Yu Kuai <yukuai@fnnas.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 22:07:29 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] md: wake raid456 reshape waiters before suspend

During raid456 reshape, direct IO across the reshape position can sleep
in raid5_make_request() waiting for reshape progress while still
holding an active_io reference. If userspace then freezes reshape and
writes md/suspend_lo or md/suspend_hi, mddev_suspend() kills active_io
and waits for all in-flight IO to drain.

This can deadlock: the IO needs reshape progress to continue, but the
reshape thread is already frozen, so the active_io reference is never
dropped and suspend never completes.

raid5_prepare_suspend() already wakes wait_for_reshape for dm-raid. Do
the same for normal md suspend when reshape is already interrupted, so
waiting raid456 IO can abort, drop its reference, and let suspend
finish.

The mdadm test tests/25raid456-reshape-deadlock reproduces the hang.

Fixes: 714d20150ed8 ("md: add new helpers to suspend/resume array")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-raid/20260327140729.2030564-1-yukuai@fnnas.com/
Signed-off-by: Yu Kuai <yukuai@fnnas.com>

diff --git a/drivers/md/md.c b/drivers/md/md.c
index 67e2b501d94f..5fb5ae8368ba 100644
--- a/drivers/md/md.c
+++ b/drivers/md/md.c
@@ -487,6 +487,17 @@ int mddev_suspend(struct mddev *mddev, bool interruptible)
 	}
 
 	percpu_ref_kill(&mddev->active_io);
+
+	/*
+	 * RAID456 IO can sleep in wait_for_reshape while still holding an
+	 * active_io reference. If reshape is already interrupted or frozen,
+	 * wake those waiters so they can abort and drop the reference instead
+	 * of deadlocking suspend.
+	 */
+	if (mddev->pers && mddev->pers->prepare_suspend &&
+	    reshape_interrupted(mddev))
+		mddev->pers->prepare_suspend(mddev);
+
 	if (interruptible)
 		err = wait_event_interruptible(mddev->sb_wait,
 				percpu_ref_is_zero(&mddev->active_io));
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file, `drivers/md/md.c`, to fix a deadlock in RAID456 reshape suspend.

### Modifications in each file

- **`drivers/md/md.c`**: In `mddev_suspend()`, after calling `percpu_ref_kill(&mddev->active_io)` and before waiting for the reference count to drop to zero, a new check and call are added. If the MD personality provides a `prepare_suspend` method and the reshape is in an interrupted/frozen state (`reshape_interrupted(mddev)`), then `mddev->pers->prepare_suspend(mddev)` is invoked.

### Relationships

The deadlock occurs because RAID456 I/O that crosses the reshape position can sleep in `raid5_make_request()` waiting for reshape progress while holding an `active_io` reference. If the reshape is frozen (e.g., by userspace writing to `md/suspend_lo/hi`), `mddev_suspend()` kills `active_io` and then waits for all references to drain. The waiting I/O never wakes up because the reshape thread is frozen, so suspend hangs indefinitely.  
The fix ensures that before waiting for I/O to drain, any sleeping I/O waiting for reshape is explicitly woken via `prepare_suspend`. This allows those I/Os to abort, drop their `active_io` reference, and let suspend proceed. The call is conditional on reshape being interrupted, matching the scenario that triggers the deadlock.
